movies.name: Inception
movies.summary: A thief who enters the dreams of others must perform the impossible task of planting an idea into a target's subconscious.

movies.name: Interstellar
movies.summary: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.

movies.name: The Dark Knight
movies.summary: Batman faces the Joker in a deadly psychological and physical test of his ability to fight injustice.

movies.name: Avatar
movies.summary: A paraplegic marine on an alien planet becomes torn between following orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.

movies.name: Titanic
movies.summary: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated RMS Titanic.

movies.name: The Matrix
movies.summary: A computer hacker learns about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.

movies.name: Gladiator
movies.summary: A former Roman general sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

movies.name: The Shawshank Redemption
movies.summary: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

movies.name: Forrest Gump
movies.summary: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, Vietnam, Watergate, and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man with a low IQ.

movies.name: Avengers: Endgame
movies.summary: After the devastating events of Infinity War, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

movies.name: Joker
movies.summary: In Gotham City, mentally troubled comedian Arthur Fleck embarks on a downward spiral of social revolution and bloody crime.

movies.name: The Lion King
movies.summary: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

movies.name: The Godfather
movies.summary: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

movies.name: Pulp Fiction
movies.summary: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in tales of violence and redemption.

movies.name: Fight Club
movies.summary: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into something much more.
